This certificate is self-verifiable: complete all 13 chapters and the capstone project.

--- ## How to Claim Your Certificate | Step | Action | Time | |------|--------|------| | 1 | Complete all 13 chapters in order | ~30 hours | | 2 | Achieve 8/10 on every Chapter Quiz | Self-check | | 3 | Complete the Ch 13 Capstone (Design Your Learning System) | ~3 hours | | 4 | Fill in your name and date on the certificate above | 5 min | | 5 | Print the page and pin it above your desk | 2 min | ## What You've Demonstrated | Skill | Verified By | |-------|-------------| | Learning system design using OODA loops | Capstone (Ch 13) | | 30-day sprint planning for any goal | Quiz + Exercises (Ch 2) | | Energy-aware daily scheduling | Quick Reference (Ch 3) | | Active recall and spaced repetition | Leitner box setup (Ch 4) | | Deep work execution | Distraction audit (Ch 5) | | Resource learning with SQ3R | Question generation (Ch 6) | | Deliberate practice with error analysis | Error log (Ch 7) | | Exam study plan creation | Gap analysis (Ch 8) | | Spiral learning and Feynman technique | Prerequisite map (Ch 9) | | Interview preparation workflow | STAR stories (Ch 10) | | Progress tracking and course correction | Daily log + weekly review (Ch 11) | | Teaching and building in public | Learning log (Ch 12) | | Integrated system design | Capstone project (Ch 13) | ## What's Next? After earning this certificate, you're ready to: 1. **Apply the system** to your actual learning goal (SSC, UPSC, FAANG, language, any skill) 2. **Revisit specific chapters** when you hit a plateau — each chapter's Common Mistakes and Quick Reference are designed for rapid lookup 3. **Teach someone else** — the best way to deepen your mastery 4. **Join the community** — share your learning system and progress publicly 5. **Explore the original course** — the Learning How to Learn reference course has 290+ Q&As for deeper dives into cognitive science
